hypotheses.explanation: Set iteration order varies with PYTHONHASHSEED; take the deterministically smallest element instead of an arbitrary one.
hypotheses.patched_code:
import sys
events = {f"evt-{i}" for i in range(8)}
first = sorted(events)[0]
sys.exit(0 if first == "evt-0" else 1)
